entry_points.text: Unlock read shows releasable holders, write releases and returns length or error; trace/timeout/freeze validate and commit, match read uses bounded formatter.
Poweroff work invokes platform routine, sysrq schedules it on first online CPU, descriptor binds o with poweroff(o), Power Off and boot mask, early init registers o.

Latency files bind on open, unbind and free on release; writes take binary int or hex text; wakeup rejects negatives, latency ignores invalid yet reports full length; init registers primary and optional wakeup, unwinds on fail.
Arch header save completes init and restore validates with mismatch outcome; boot parser maps sleep names; alarm test drives suspends with fallback; RTC matcher finds alarm-capable wake devices.

exports.text: Wakelock lock/unlock by name with optional lock timeout; privilege-gated, shared registry plus wakeup-source delegation and recency refresh.
QoS aggregate read, target/flags updates, CPU latency limit and add/remove/apply; raising aggregate wakes idle CPUs.
Freq QoS init/read/add/update/remove plus per-kind notifier add/remove and add/update/remove dispatcher; chains blocking, sleepable only.
Power globals: freezer timeout ms default 20s, freeze flag, trace flag, main workqueue; early inits for labels and hibernate sizes; highmem count 0 here.
Hibernation safe-page alloc, nosave interval registry with coalesce, image alloc/save with admission and copy/zero/meta accounting.
Sleep ops installers refresh visible states; s2idle wake signals one waiter; predicates report idle-default and mem-only validity.

hazards.text: Enabling trace perturbs wall clock needing manual fix; unprivileged or malformed inputs fail without side effects.

Wakeup writes reject negatives, latency silently discards invalid yet reports full length; reclaim deferred to threshold and workqueue; poweroff to first online CPU; map failures warn once and proceed; nosave assumes alloc never fails; zero pages via accumulated words with slot reuse.
Snapshot selectors: dummy LZO 0, platform 1, nocompress 2, CRC 4, HWsig 8, LZ4 16; image alloc reclaimable without fail warnings; page safety any/keep 0, safe/clear 1; test interval 10s and delay 5.
Depends on external alloc, list, spin/mutex, parse, copy, warn, cpu/mask, memory and notifier helpers owned outside D13; pass 1 treats them as interface only.

invariants.text: Lock needs privilege and non-empty name to whitespace, optional decimal ns timeout rounded up to ms; unlock strips one newline and needs existing entry; malformed rejected.

Exact match by prefix plus length; lookup miss fails invalid, create miss fails on limit/alloc/register else links zeroed entry with dup name, source and timestamp; lru/limit/count/gc have active/inert variants.

Empty target gives no-constraint, min smallest, max largest, unknown warns plus default; add/update insert, remove deletes, refresh, trace, notify only on change; flags union with zero empty, remove recomputes, update is remove plus add.

Negative invalid except default sentinel; inactive unbound and active bound; duplicate add and inactive update/remove warn and ignore; unchanged skipped; removal detaches and clears; freq min uses max-aggregation, max uses min-aggregation, per-kind chain, missing reads default.
Stores validate before commit: timeout base-ten unsigned, freeze only 0/1, trace decimal to bool; failures leave state unchanged.

Reserved scales spare 1MiB, image scales total two-fifths; saveable equals copied plus zero, meta proportional; admission needs free low memory beyond request plus 4MiB reserve minus allocated/highmem; direct copy when present else temp map; highmem local maps with buffer when only dest high.

Nosave intervals sorted with tail coalesce, empty/inverted ignored; suspend tables fixed 3-state labels plus sleep names; current alias maps to suspend-on; current/default evolve only via boot parse and ops install.

locks.text: Wakelocks mutex serializes lookup/create, activation/relaxation, recency and GC accounting across lock/unlock, held whole section.
QoS spinlock with irq save guards target/flags mutation and refresh; stored target via single-copy atomics; latency read samples under lock, other limits lockless.
Ops install holds system sleep guard across update plus refresh; s2idle wake checks/updates under raw spinlock with irqs saved, signals only on active to wake.

state_machines.text: Wakelock absent to present on create with register plus timestamp, recency refreshed on lock/unlock, active vs relaxed on lock/unlock, deferred reclaim after counter threshold.
Bring-up starts workqueues named pm and pm_fs_sync first, teardown first if second fails, then sizes, kobject, sysfs, timing, autosleep, abort on first failure.

Test stages none to core, processors, platform, devices, freezer, sentinel with first/last bounds default none; sleep starts from boot option then refines when ops appear; idle unchanged when idle/waking else active substate to wake once.
Image path checks admission, allocates and copies, early exit on shortage or alloc fail, zero excluded; alarm test tries deep then shallow then idle, repeats to count then disables.

structs.text: swsusp_info: uts, version u32, num_physpages ulong, cpus int, image_pages/pages/size ulong, page-aligned; snapshot cursor cur index, buffer pointer, sync_read flag; arch max equals identity size plus 4.
Constraints combine ordered list, target/default/no-constraint values, min/max type and optional notifier; flags combine list with effective union cache.
Sysfs null-terminated attr array always with state plus conditional features, group wraps array, groups array optionally appends sleep group; generated attrs 644 and read-only.
Latency devices pair open/release/read/write/no-op seek file ops with dynamic-minor miscdev; names cpu_dma_latency and cpu_wakeup_latency.

Snapshot memory: packed linked page; chain head/used/mask/safe-only; radix node list plus page array; zone header links, lists, range, root, levels/blocks; bitmap zones, backing, cursor; extent/nosave ranges; highmem copy/orig/next; payload page minus pointer, entries per page, PFN MSB zero flag, end all-bits with page shift/mask.
